key.name: show-indicator
key.summary: Show Global Menu
key.description: Master toggle for the whole global menu bar.

key.name: menu-app-enabled
key.summary: Show App menu

key.name: menu-file-enabled
key.summary: Show File menu

key.name: menu-edit-enabled
key.summary: Show Edit menu

key.name: menu-view-enabled
key.summary: Show View menu

key.name: menu-go-enabled
key.summary: Show Go menu

key.name: menu-window-enabled
key.summary: Show Window menu

key.name: menu-help-enabled
key.summary: Show Help menu

key.name: use-real-menus
key.summary: Show the real menus of apps that export them
key.description: Replaces the generic menus with the app's own menu bar when the app exports it (GTK menu bars, LibreOffice, Qt, Chromium, Electron, Firefox). Also provides com.canonical.AppMenu.Registrar and the org_kde_kwin_appmenu_manager Wayland global, which make those apps export their menu and hide their in-window menu bar.

key.name: show-actions-menu
key.summary: Show the Actions menu for apps without a menu bar
key.description: GTK 4 apps have no menu bar, but export their actions; list them in an Actions menu.

key.name: generic-menus-enabled
key.summary: Show generic menus for apps that export none

key.name: app-name-bold
key.summary: Show the app name in bold

key.name: show-app-icon
key.summary: Show the app icon next to its name

key.name: button-padding
key.summary: Horizontal padding of each menu title, in pixels

key.name: clock-position
key.summary: Where the clock sits in the top bar
key.description: center: the GNOME default. right: next to the system indicators. far-right: after the system indicators.

key.name: window-list-enabled
key.summary: Show a window switcher in the top bar
key.description: A button that lists the open windows, most recently used first; choosing one switches to it.

key.name: window-list-shortcut
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut that opens the window switcher

key.name: screenshot-button-enabled
key.summary: Show a screenshot button in the top bar
key.description: One click takes a capture with GNOME Shell's own screenshot tool; a secondary click lists the other kinds of capture.

key.name: screenshot-click-action
key.summary: What a click on the screenshot button does
key.description: interactive: open the capture overlay to pick an area, a window or the screen. screen: capture the whole screen at once. window: capture the focused window at once. menu: open the button's menu.

key.name: clipboard-enabled
key.summary: Keep a clipboard history
key.description: Shows a button in the top bar listing what was copied recently. The history is kept in memory only, never written to disk, and skips what password managers mark as secret.

key.name: clipboard-history-size
key.summary: How many copied items to remember

key.name: clipboard-retention
key.summary: How long a copied item is remembered

key.name: clipboard-paste-on-select
key.summary: Paste an item into the focused window when it is chosen

key.name: clipboard-shortcut
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut that opens the clipboard history

key.name: custom-menus
key.summary: JSON list of custom menu sections
key.description: Each entry: {label, enabled, items: [{label, kind: "command"|"shortcut", value}]}. Supports any number of independent custom top-level menus.

key.name: show-logo-menu
key.summary: Show the System Menu button

key.name: logo-icon-name
key.summary: System icon name for the System Menu button

key.name: logo-custom-icon-path
key.summary: Path to a custom icon file for the System Menu button
key.description: Highest priority: when non-empty, overrides everything else.

key.name: logo-distro-icon
key.summary: Bundled distro icon stem (e.g. "fedora", "arch"), empty for none

key.name: logo-distro-icon-symbolic
key.summary: Use the symbolic (single-color) variant of the bundled distro icon

key.name: logo-icon-size
key.summary: Icon size in pixels for the System Menu button

key.name: hide-overview-button
key.summary: Hide the Activities/overview button

key.name: show-app-grid
key.summary: Show App Grid item in System Menu

key.name: show-software-center
key.summary: Show Software Center item

key.name: software-center-command
key.summary: Command for Software Center

key.name: show-system-monitor
key.summary: Show System Monitor item

key.name: system-monitor-command
key.summary: Command for System Monitor

key.name: show-terminal
key.summary: Show Terminal item

key.name: terminal-command
key.summary: Command for Terminal

key.name: show-extensions-app
key.summary: Show Extensions item

key.name: extensions-app-id
key.summary: Desktop file ID of the extensions manager app to launch

key.name: show-force-quit
key.summary: Show Force Quit App item

key.name: show-power-options
key.summary: Show Sleep/Restart/Shut Down items

key.name: show-lock-screen
key.summary: Show Lock Screen item

key.name: show-log-out
key.summary: Show Log Out item

key.name: system-menu-custom-items
key.summary: JSON list of custom shell-command items added to the System Menu
key.description: Each entry: {label, value}. Appears as its own section at the bottom of the System Menu.

key.name: desktop-app-name
key.summary: Name shown for the file manager / desktop placeholder in the App menu
key.description: Used for the App menu label and File menu items (e.g. "About X", "Open X", "New X Window") when no other app is focused.

key.name: debug-logging
key.summary: Enable verbose error logging to the system journal
key.description: Off by default to avoid excessive logging; turn on temporarily when diagnosing an issue.
